criteria.statement: Below 768px exactly one side renders at a time via a two-tab control, both totals and difference visible on either tab
Switching tabs preserves each side's visible entries/quantities and does not reload the page
At and above 768px both sides render side by side, matching today's shipped composition
Tab control measures >=44px in its smaller dimension and shows a visible focus ring
Per-side search input and Scan button each measure >=44px in their smaller dimension
Both sides show real card names and real prices
Page theme is visually consistent with slice C's token/motif system
Page embeds or links the slice-B before screenshot for Trade Balancer
No official Wizards of the Coast artwork appears anywhere on the page
Cleanup evidence recorded: browser closed, owned server stopped, ports released, capture path recorded
